title: Auto Setup: Install Sites Without the Setup Screen | Orchard Core
description:
An Orchard Core site that is not installed starts on the Setup screen, where a person answers questions about the site, its recipe, its database and its administrator. A script, a container or a deployment pipeline has no one to answer them.

The Auto Setup module answers the same questions from configuration, so a site installs itself on its first request. This video registers the module, configures a tenant, keeps the secrets out of files, and shows what happens when it runs.

In this video:
• The Setup screen and the questions Auto Setup answers
• Registering the module in the host
• Configuring a tenant: site name, recipe, time zone, administrator and database
• Keeping secrets in environment variables and user secrets
• The first request: a site installs itself, and you log in
• More than one site, and the AutoSetupPath
• Validation, failures, and several instances with a lock
